steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: confirm-flag-on
steps.eval: (() => { if (!window.__store.getState().featureFlags.settingOutDims) throw new Error('settingOutDims should default ON in Pro mode') })()

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__capturedHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: assert-setting-out-datum-and-tile-marks
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const need = (re, label) => { if (!re.test(html)) throw new Error('missing: ' + label) }; need(/SETTING-OUT DATUM/, 'setting-out datum label'); need(/Tile setting-out point — start laying here, verify joints on site/, 'tile setting-out note'); window.__scenarioOk = true; })()

steps.name: verify-a-known-face-distance
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const plan = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const ext = plan.walls.filter((w) => w.thickness === 'external'); if (!ext.length) throw new Error('no external walls'); let minX = Infinity, minZ = Infinity; for (const w of ext) for (const p of [w.start, w.end]) { if (p[0] < minX) minX = p[0]; if (p[1] < minZ) minZ = p[1] } const datum = [minX, minZ]; const half = (w) => (w.thicknessM ?? (w.thickness === 'external' ? 0.2 : 0.1)) / 2; const wall = ext.find((w) => Math.abs(w.end[1]-w.start[1]) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(w.end[0]-w.start[0]) > 1e-6); if (!wall) throw new Error('no horizontal external wall found'); const centreZ = wall.start[1]; const h = half(wall); const sign = (centreZ - datum[1]) < 0 ? 1 : -1; const faceZ = centreZ + sign * h; const distance = faceZ - datum[1]; const label = distance.toFixed(2) + ' m'; if (!html.includes(label)) throw new Error('expected face distance label not found: ' + label); window.__faceDistanceOk = label; })()

steps.name: scroll-to-dimensioned-plan-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')].find((e) => e.textContent && e.textContent.includes('Dimensioned plan')); (h ? h.closest('.sheet') || h : document.body).scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }) })()

steps.name: scroll-to-floor-plan-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')].find((e) => e.textContent && /^Floor plan/.test(e.textContent.trim())); (h ? h.closest('.sheet') || h : document.body).scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }) })()
